cl_f_L_per_hr.note: Approximate apparent oral clearance at steady state for lorlatinib; clearance increases with repeat dosing due to autoinduction.

t_half_hr.note: Approximate reported lorlatinib elimination half-life after a single dose; used as an estimate for the model.

tau_hr.note: Planned oral dosing is once daily.

fu.note: Lorlatinib is approximately 66% bound to plasma proteins.

ic50_nM.note: Estimated representative cellular IC50 for lorlatinib against ALK-positive cells; the protocol does not specify an assay or value.

mw.note: Molecular weight of lorlatinib, in g/mol.
